summary: Transport Corporation of India posted Q2 consolidated net profit of 1.16B rupees, up from 1.13B rupees YoY, surpassing the analyst estimate of 1.12B rupees.

headline: SC suggests 16% margin cap on medicines
summary: The Supreme Court has suggested a 16% margin cap on medicines, a development that could impact hospital and healthcare companies including Fortis Healthcare and Apollo Hospitals.

headline: Cipla targets $1 billion North America revenue by FY27
summary: Cipla plans to reach $1 billion revenue in North America by FY27. The strategy focuses on growth through new product launches in the region.

headline: Akshar Spintex Q2FY27 Results
summary: Akshar Spintex Ltd reports a net profit of ₹30.45 lakh for Q2FY27, turning profitable from a loss in the year-ago quarter. Revenue from operations rose 59.7% YoY to ₹3,569.05 lakh.

headline: Indo Credit Capital Q2FY27 Results: Loss widens to ₹9.56 lakh
summary: Indo Credit Capital reported a standalone net loss of ₹9.56 lakh in Q2FY27, widening from a profit of ₹3.41 lakh in Q2FY26 due to zero income and higher expenses.

headline: Shanti Spintex submits revised H1FY26 results
summary: Shanti Spintex Limited filed revised standalone financial results for the half year ended September 30, 2025, correcting an XBRL error. Net profit stood at ₹356 lakh.

headline: IndiaMART Q2FY27 PAT up 9.8% to ₹908 million
summary: IndiaMART InterMESH Ltd reported a 9.8% YoY rise in consolidated net profit for Q2FY27. Revenue grew 9.6% YoY, driven by strong web services performance.

headline: Bajaj Auto Q2 EBITDA jumps 37% to ₹41.7 billion
summary: Bajaj Auto reported Q2 EBITDA of ₹41.7 billion, up from ₹30.52 billion YoY, beating estimates of ₹39.15 billion. Net profit rose to ₹33.5 billion.

headline: Chemkart India invests ₹97.90 lakh in subsidiary
summary: Chemkart India Limited infused ₹97.90 lakh into wholly owned subsidiary Easy Raw Materials Private Limited via rights issue to fund manufacturing unit commissioning.

headline: Alembic Pharma gets USFDA nod for Valganciclovir oral solution
summary: Alembic Pharmaceuticals received final USFDA approval for Valganciclovir for Oral Solution, 50 mg/mL. The company now holds 247 cumulative ANDA approvals from the USFDA.

headline: Maruti Q2 profit falls to ₹25B
summary: Maruti Suzuki reported a net profit of ₹25 billion in Q2, down from ₹33 billion YoY. Revenue rose to ₹533 billion, beating estimates, while EBITDA margin contracted.

headline: Siyaram Silk Mills Q2 EBITDA rises to ₹117 crore
summary: Siyaram Silk Mills reported Q2 EBITDA of ₹117 crore, up from ₹110 crore YoY. However, net profit fell to ₹75 crore as margins contracted to 14.07%.

headline: GPT Healthcare appoints Cygnus Partners as IR agency
summary: GPT Healthcare Limited has appointed Cygnus Partners Private Limited as its Investor Relations advisory agency to enhance market visibility and transparency.

headline: Skipper Ltd seeks shareholder nod for Rabindra Nath Nayak as Independent Director
summary: Skipper Limited has issued a postal ballot notice for the appointment of Rabindra Nath Nayak as an Independent Director. E-voting is open from October 29 to November 27, 2026.

headline: Vadilal Enterprises approves SPA with Vadilal Industries
summary: Vadilal Enterprises Limited shareholders approved the execution of a sale and purchase agreement with Vadilal Industries Limited during an EGM held on October 27, 2026.

headline: Indoco's AnaCipher gets ANVISA Brazil approval
summary: Indoco Remedies' CRO, AnaCipher, received ANVISA Brazil approval for clinical and bioanalytical facilities. This enables BA/BE studies for Brazil submissions.

headline: Bajaj Auto appoints Pallavi Joshi Bakhru as director
summary: Bajaj Auto appoints Pallavi Joshi Bakhru as Non-executive Independent Director for five years from Jan 1, 2027, subject to shareholder approval.

headline: Bajaj Auto appoints Madhusudan Gopalan as CPO
summary: Bajaj Auto appoints Madhusudan Gopalan, former P&G SVP, as Chief Product Officer effective November 16, 2026. He brings over two decades of global leadership experience.

headline: Fortis Malar Hospitals director reshuffle
summary: Fortis Malar Hospitals Ltd appointed Dr. S Narayani as Non-Executive Non-Independent Director, replacing Dr. Ritu Garg who resigned on October 27, 2026.

headline: Bajaj Auto elevates Kailash Zanzari to COO
summary: Bajaj Auto Limited announced the designation change of Kailash Zanzari from Chief Product Officer to Chief Operating Officer, effective October 27, 2026.

headline: LT Foods Q2FY27 consolidated net profit up 10% YoY
summary: LT Foods reported consolidated net profit of ₹18,019.89 lakhs for Q2FY27, up from ₹16,385.37 lakhs a year ago. Consolidated revenue from operations rose to ₹3,23,414.34 lakhs.

headline: Honeywell Automation Q2FY27 PAT up 11.8% YoY
summary: Honeywell Automation India reported a 11.8% YoY rise in standalone net profit to ₹1,337 million for Q2FY27, driven by revenue growth to ₹12,239 million.

headline: Kirloskar Brothers Q2 net profit up 3.5% YoY
summary: Kirloskar Brothers reported a consolidated net profit of ₹747 million for Q2, up from ₹722 million a year ago. Revenue rose 24.3% YoY to ₹12.77 billion.

headline: Beryl Securities raises ₹2.7 crore via preferential allotment
summary: Beryl Securities approved the allotment of 11.78 lakh equity shares at ₹23 per share to promoters and public shareholders, raising ₹2.71 crore.

headline: Gujarat Poly Avx Q2FY27 PAT up 73%
summary: Gujarat Poly Avx Electronics reported Q2FY27 net profit of ₹7.35 crore, rising 73% YoY. Revenue from operations increased 24% to ₹55.47 crore.

headline: Raymond Q2FY27 revenue up 24% YoY to ₹6,551.6 crore
summary: Raymond reported a 24.1% YoY rise in consolidated revenue to ₹6,551.6 crore for Q2FY27, with profit from continuing operations at ₹320.6 crore. The board approved the unaudited financial results on October 27, 2026.

headline: TBZ Q2 EBITDA falls to ₹47 crore
summary: Tribhovandas Bhimji Zaveri Q2 EBITDA dropped to ₹47 crore from ₹63.1 crore. Net profit halved to ₹15.4 crore despite marginal revenue growth.

headline: ATV Projects Q2FY27 PAT jumps 320% YoY
summary: ATV Projects India Ltd reported a 320% YoY rise in Q2FY27 profit to ₹619.53 lakh, driven by a ₹407.31 lakh exceptional gain from land sale deeds.

headline: Honeywell appoints Pamela Banerjee as Internal Auditor
summary: Honeywell Automation India appointed Pamela Banerjee as Internal Auditor effective October 27, 2026. She brings expertise from Deloitte, Novartis, and PWC.

headline: Veerhealth Care shares investor meeting recording
summary: Veerhealth Care Ltd disclosed the outcome of its analyst meeting held on October 24, 2026. The company confirmed no unpublished price-sensitive information was shared during the virtual session.

headline: Baroda Extrusion Q2FY27: Net profit jumps 184% YoY
summary: Baroda Extrusion reported a sharp rise in quarterly net profit to ₹354.45 lakh, driven by strong revenue growth and improved margins in Q2FY27.

headline: Deepak Fertilisers appoints Pankaj Gupta as CS
summary: Deepak Fertilisers & Petrochemicals Corporation Limited has appointed Pankaj Gupta as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer effective November 1, 2026.

headline: CSL Finance appoints Akshay Gujar as CEO-SME
summary: CSL Finance Limited has appointed Akshay Gujar as the Chief Executive Officer of its SME Division, effective October 27, 2026. Gujar brings over 12 years of experience in retail lending and MSME finance.

headline: R&B Denims grants ₹1.5 crore unsecured loan
summary: R&B Denims approved a ₹1.5 crore unsecured loan to Shilpa Dyeing at 13.80% interest. The transaction is non-related party and lacks security.

headline: Aditya Infotech taps Ranveer Singh for CP PLUS
summary: Aditya Infotech appoints Ranveer Singh as brand ambassador for CP PLUS to boost smart security adoption across India.

headline: One 97 Communications updates fair disclosure code
summary: One 97 Communications Limited amended its Code of Practices for Fair Disclosure of UPSI, approved by the Board on October 26, 2026. The update ensures compliance with SEBI PIT Regulations.

headline: Bajaj Healthcare Q2FY27: PAT up 27%, Rev up 19%
summary: Bajaj Healthcare reported a 26.9% YoY rise in Q2FY27 PAT to ₹14.1 crore. Revenue grew 18.9% to ₹175.9 crore, driven by strong formulation and export API growth.

headline: Ugar Sugar Q2FY27 Results: Loss widens to ₹33 crore
summary: Ugar Sugar Works reported a net loss of ₹33.37 crore for Q2FY27, widening from ₹32.17 crore in the year-ago quarter. Revenue from operations fell 17.7% YoY to ₹35.00 crore.

headline: Maruti Suzuki Oct-Mar car sales seen higher YoY
summary: Maruti Suzuki's car sales for the October to March period are expected to be higher on a year-on-year basis, with potential double-digit growth anticipated.

headline: Viram Suvarn Q2FY27 PAT falls 9% YoY
summary: Viram Suvarn Limited reported a standalone net profit of ₹145.00 lakh for Q2FY27, down 9.26% YoY, despite revenue from operations rising 55.2% to ₹1,005.62 lakh.

headline: Supra Pacific Q2FY27 PAT up 57% YoY
summary: Supra Pacific Financial Services reported a 57% YoY rise in standalone net profit to ₹2.77 crore for Q2FY27, driven by strong interest income growth and improved operational efficiency.

headline: Suditi Industries investor presentation October 2026
summary: Suditi Industries submitted its updated investor presentation for October 2026, highlighting a 5-year revenue CAGR of 19%, ROE of 21%, and a strategic pivot toward branded kidswear under Gini & Jony.
